purpose: Teach: 取りまとめ/ファックス/激励/主査/次官/母体/個室/衣服

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査情報の取りまとめを進めておられますね
lines.en: The police are moving forward with compiling investigative information.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Speaking as though noting standard procedure. Warm but professional. No urgency—matter-of-fact respect for the work being done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地方署とのファックスでの連絡もされてますね
lines.en: The police are also communicating with the local precinct via fax.
lines.style: Same steady pace. A slight nod in the voice—acknowledging coordination. Still collaborative in tone, no edge. Just noticing the practical steps being taken.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新人警官への激励をされてますね
lines.en: The police are encouraging the newer officers.
lines.style: A tiny warmth enters. Still measured, but there's approval underneath. Soft on 「激励」—gentle recognition that this matters. No sentimentality, just human notice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査本部の主査も会議に出られますね
lines.en: The investigation headquarters' deputy chief is attending the meetings.
lines.style: Back to steady documentation. Clear, factual delivery. A small emphasis on the hierarchy—not critical, just noting the structure. Still warm underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、元次官の不正にも厳しく対応されますね
lines.en: The police are responding strictly to the former vice-minister's misconduct.
lines.style: Firmness enters here. Not angry, but conviction. A sharper attack on the opening. The tone says 'they're not letting this slide.' Professional, but with an undertone of approval for that seriousness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の母体組織を市民に説明されますね
lines.en: The police are explaining the investigation's organizational structure to the public.
lines.style: Back to the even keel. Noticing transparency as a good thing. No performance, just acknowledging that they're doing the work of public trust. Calm, steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、取調べ用の個室を整備されてますね
lines.en: The police have prepared private rooms for interrogations.
lines.style: Still steady, but now there's a careful gentleness. The focus shifts slightly—this is about victim care, not just procedure. Quieter on the ending. Approving but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の衣服を証拠物として保管されますね
lines.en: The police are keeping the victim's clothing as evidence.
lines.style: Slower now. Quieter. The tone becomes more intimate and serious—this is tender ground. No rush. A slight pause before continuing, as if handling something fragile. Deep respect, deep care in the delivery.
